name: canonical-workplan
description: Canonical workplan template for feature and requirement implementation

sections.title: Notes and Decisions

variables.name: milestones
variables.value:
- [ ] Phase 1: Requirements Analysis
- [ ] Phase 2: Implementation
- [ ] Phase 3: Testing & Documentation

variables.name: technicalDecisions
variables.value:
- Use dependency injection pattern for testability
- All imports must use @/ pattern
- No fallbacks or mock data outside tests
- Throw descriptive errors for unimplemented features
- Keep files under 500 lines

variables.name: openQuestions
variables.value: - No open questions at this time

variables.name: designRationale
variables.value:
- Template-based approach ensures consistency
- Interface-first design enables testability
- Dependency injection supports modularity

variables.name: futureConsiderations
variables.value:
- Support for custom templates
- Integration with version control
- Automated progress tracking
